CustomField.description: Comma-delimited list of User Ids, wrapped in leading/trailing commas (",id1,id2,") for safe LIKE '%,id,%' matching, set when Audience_Type__c = 'User'. Replaces the single-value Target_User__c Lookup, which a multi-select audience can't use — that field is no longer written to but is left in place rather than deleted since no schema-delete is warranted for an unused field.
CustomField.label: Target User Id List
